description: Accessions from nes_negatives_leucine_zipper_expansion/nes_negatives.csv deliberately EXCLUDED from ML hard-negative training (see load_hard_negative_examples in nes_ml_predictor_improved.py), so a genuine, never-trained-on reserve of hard leucine-zipper/coiled-coil negatives always exists for future holdout testing (run_holdout_pipeline_test.py). Includes the 5 accessions already used in the 2026-07-27 holdout test (P97875, O54724, O35841, O54826, Q32L17) plus a further ~10% deterministic random sample of the remaining pool (seed 20260727), for roughly 15% of the expansion set reserved in total. Regenerate only if you deliberately want a different reserve -- changing this file changes what counts as a valid held-out test.
